subject: bicycle
name: 自行车
label: 带篮子的城市自行车
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One step-through city bicycle in mild three-quarter view, front basket, rear rack, clearly connected frame and pedals, four spokes per visible wheel. Simplification correction: spacious clean-line children's drawing, not a technical illustration. Basket is a plain open trapezoid with only THREE vertical lines, no mesh or weave. Exactly four simple spoke strokes per wheel. Omit cables, tire tread, bolts, gears and shading. Plain empty interiors. Complete bicycle occupies at most 76 percent of square width.
